info.title: PAIMOS API
info.description:
PAIMOS — Professional & Personal AI Project OS.

This is the **public, stable scriptable contract** for PAIMOS — the canonical resource surface used by the SPA, the paimos CLI, and custom integrations: auth, users, projects, issues, comments, time entries, attachments, documents, incidents, knowledge, and GDPR ops. It is intentionally a curated subset. Internal one-off admin tooling (CSV/Jira/mite imports, dev test reports, branding writes, SSO/TOTP management, AI operations, portal internals) is deliberately omitted and is NOT part of the stability contract — those endpoints exist but may change without notice. Authentication is either a session cookie (browser) or a `paimos_*` bearer API key (machine-to-machine). Coverage policy & contribution rule: PAI-294.

On version-1 delivery-instrumented implementation runs, tests_passed also requires an allowlisted commit, source-free implementation digest, or same-issue attachment and atomically projects implementation plus required QA success; legacy runs are not backfilled.

ExternalStageOwnerActivationRequest.description: Both current-stage expectations must be zero for the first execution, or both positive and exact for a terminal retry.

ExternalStageHandoffMetadata.description: Safe metadata only. The raw or encoded handoff secret is never a JSON field.

ExternalStagePharosEvidence.description: Symbolic allowlisted workflow/environment and exact artifact identity only; no command, path, callback, or URL fields exist.

ExternalStageJanusEvidence.description: Value-free enum, boolean, and timestamp facts only; no free text, opaque ID, path, URL, digest, version, ciphertext, command, callback, or secret field exists.

ExternalStageReportRequest.description: The registered reporter class and server-owned ceiling select the permitted evidence variant; body fields never grant class or role.

text.description: The authoritative producer bound is 8192 UTF-8 bytes: the server truncates the transcript to at most 8192 bytes on a code-point boundary, so the value is always valid UTF-8. JSON Schema maxLength counts characters (code points) rather than bytes, so this 8192 maxLength is only a loose upper bound that multibyte transcripts never reach; validate the byte length against 8192 when the byte bound matters.

candidate_ids.description: Empty for status/note_ready; one to three active authorized delivery IDs for clarification.

selected_delivery.description: Selected delivery key, or the empty string when the authorized history is genuinely empty.

HarnessCapabilities.description: Capabilities advertised by the harness and capped by durable adapter/target policy; never a server certification of vendor behavior.

HarnessSession.description: Non-secret durable harness identity. The private harness session reference is encrypted in the message target and is never returned.

harness_session_ref.description: Opaque private reference; encrypted at rest and never logged or returned.

worker_lease.description: Private 256-bit generation lease. Only its scope-bound SHA-256 digest is stored; it is never returned.

message_target_id.description: Existing encrypted target binding required for unmanaged inboxes.

text.description: Trimmed UTF-8 transcript, at most 8192 encoded bytes, without control characters.

ProductSession.description: A first-class product session. product_session_id is never an attribution UUID/header session, harness_session_id, agent_run_id, delivery identity, or intake_session_id.

ProductSessionEvent.description: Append-only audit evidence emitted atomically with the product-session mutation. Node IDs are historical snapshots.

short_body.description: At most 1,200 UTF-8 bytes; the server enforces bytes, not code points.

LegacyStructuredKnowledgeEntry.description: Explicit legacy candidate; purpose and body are withheld until reviewed adoption.

candidate_body.description: At most 64 KiB UTF-8 bytes; the server enforces bytes.

short_body.description: Candidate cap is 64 KiB UTF-8 bytes; durable creation is limited to 1,200 bytes.

StructuredKnowledgePromote.description: Only project to instance and instance to kernel or vision are valid. Direct project to a terminal level is prohibited.

StructuredKnowledgePromotionResult.description: Atomic promotion receipt. Destination, immutable evidence, canonical-link outcomes, and source soft-deletion commit together or not at all.

Node.description: Presentation-only one-node DTO over an existing issues row. kind is always node and cosmetic_type_label never changes legacy issue storage.

CommandPaletteShortcut.description: Canonical ordered chord: Mod, Ctrl, Meta, Alt, Shift, then one code from KeyA-KeyZ, Digit0-Digit9, Space, Slash, Backslash, BracketLeft, BracketRight, Semicolon, Quote, Comma, Period, Minus, Equal, Backquote. Mod excludes Ctrl/Meta; one of Mod/Ctrl/Meta/Alt is required. Mod/Ctrl/Meta plus optional Shift collides on KeyR/KeyL/KeyW/KeyQ/KeyT/KeyN/KeyP/KeyF or Digit1-Digit9.

NotFound.description: Resource not found, or hidden from caller for privacy

PermissionsEpoch.description: PAI-320 per-user permissions epoch. The auth middleware sets it on every authenticated response, for session-cookie and `paimos_*` API-key callers alike, so it is always present on a success. The value is the canonical base-10 rendering of a non-negative int64 counter: no sign, no leading zeros, no surrounding whitespace. Clients compare it verbatim against the last value they saw and re-fetch `/auth/me` on any change, so a non-canonical rendering would silently invalidate that comparison. The pattern is exact on both ends: the counter is a signed int64 column rendered by `strconv.FormatInt`, so 9223372036854775807 is the largest value that can ever appear. The 19-digit alternatives encode that ceiling — one branch per prefix of the maximum whose next digit is lowered, plus the maximum itself — because JSON Schema has no numeric bound for a string-typed header.

SessionExpiresAt.description: PAI-322 session expiry. Present only when the request authenticated with a session cookie; absent for `paimos_*` API-key callers, so clients must treat it as optional. The value is the session's current expiry in UTC as an RFC 3339 date-time.

get.summary: Stream resumable Agent Mode delivery invalidations
get.description: Server-Sent Events stream. `Last-Event-ID` has absolute precedence over `cursor`. A valid resume produces durable `refetch` events with only currently authorized hints or identity-free `refetch` when convergence requires it, and `checkpoint` events when only the opaque high-water advances. Both use the new opaque cursor as the SSE `id`. Any invalid/tampered/expired/wrong-user/wrong-scope/revoked/below-retention/ahead-of-tail resume produces exactly one identity-free `reset` (`{"schema_version":1,"reason":"resync_required"}`) without an event id, then closes. A fresh stream whose authorized scope exceeds 1,000 candidates returns a private 400 before SSE headers; a resumed stream normalizes that changed scope to the same generic reset. A storage invariant discovered before response headers is a private 500 problem because cursor resynchronization cannot repair storage; the same invariant discovered by an already-established session emits one identity-free reset and closes. Heartbeats are SSE comments.

200.description: SSE `reset`, `refetch`, and `checkpoint` events. Refetch/checkpoint data follows AgentModeStreamBatch; reset data follows AgentModeStreamReset.

schema.description: UTF-8 SSE frames. Event data schemas: AgentModeStreamBatch for refetch/checkpoint; AgentModeStreamReset for reset.

400.description: Malformed non-cursor filter or a fresh authorized scope exceeding 1,000 candidates. Invalid cursor material and a resumed scope that no longer satisfies the bound are normalized to a 200 reset event.

404.description: Canonical external concealment before a stream is opened

403.description: Authenticated internal caller must change an administrator-set password before a stream is opened

500.description: Private pre-stream storage invariant or unavailable streaming transport; no SSE headers have been committed

post.description: The registered key-to-reporter binding selects class, role, dependency, and evidence ceiling. Dependency reports never write canonical owner latest. Verification remains deployed-unverified unless exact artifact and environment evidence is observed and server-received after the matching deployment receipt. A nonterminal reporter is stale after two minutes without a server receipt; stale semantic progress is rejected until an exact-next heartbeat restores liveness, and reporter timestamps never extend this deadline.

get.description: Composes durable product sessions with target-agent inbox and exception attention, nullable nodes, and fresh unambiguous M161 harness truth. Paimos is an explicit target. Ambiguous, stale, ownership-mismatched, and cross-project harness candidates fail closed. This does not change Agent Mode schema v1.

post.summary: Deliver one finalized Paimos 6 transcript
post.description: Accepts transcript text only; raw audio is never part of this request. A selected session is reauthorized with its current revision, project, node, agent, harness, and encrypted delivery target in the commit transaction. Null selection continues the authenticated user's explicit project-scoped Paimos conversation. Exact retries return the original 201 result; a changed request under the same utterance ID conflicts.

201.description: First commit or exact replay; always private and no-store.

409.description: Stale selection, unavailable target, or conflicting replay.
